response.jobTitle: Application Support Specialist - Digital & IT Application Operations
response.jobDescription:
Role Definition

An experienced team contributor who independently handles standard technical, functional or operational assignments and supports more complex work under guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Work execution

  • Test, deploy or support assigned components.
  • Complete standard assignments within agreed timelines and quality standards.
  • Follow approved processes, technical standards and security requirements.
  • Maintain accurate work records and technical documentation.


Support and operations

  • Resolve standard incidents and service requests.
  • Perform monitoring, maintenance, testing and administrative activities.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk issues with appropriate diagnostic information.
  • Participate in user training, releases, upgrades and planned maintenance.


Collaboration

  • Coordinate with colleagues, users and support teams.
  • Participate in project meetings, reviews and improvement activities.
  • Share lessons learned and update knowledge articles.

 

Additional Responsibilities

  • Contribute to small enhancements and automation initiatives.
  • Assist with data preparation, testing and deployment activities.
  • Participate in user-support and training sessions.
  • Contribute to problem investigations under guidance.

 

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree, diploma, relevant technical qualification or equivalent professional experience.
  • Normally 2 to 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in working with tools like Documentum, Supplier Connect, JIRA, DevOps is desired.
  • OpenText Documentum experience is added as advantage
